content:
I'll be doing a short intro to Lean+Mathlib with a live-demo at the April PyData Exeter aimed at newcomers and beginners. Short means it will all have to fit into 20 mins.

The aim is to demystify proof assistants so that more people might have a go themselves.

https://www.meetup.com/pydata-exeter/events/306511193/?eventOrigin=group_upcoming_events

If you're in the area, feel free to pop along and say hello!
